all.release_notes: Adds Quick Records for faster livestock work entries, expands treatment and farm-work record types, and adapts the setup form for medicine, pregnancy, weight, movement, ID, vet procedure and other animal records.

windows.release_notes: Fixes invoice item saving and refreshes the Windows desktop build.

android.release_notes: Fixes Android update package identity so the APK updates the existing app, improves invoice item saving, and keeps on-device printed tag OCR in the installed Android app.

ios.release_notes: Adds Quick Records to the online app. iPhone and iPad users can use the live Farming Ledger web app and add it to the Home Screen.

chrome.release_notes: Adds Quick Records, expanded livestock record types and adaptive setup fields to the web app.

web.release_notes: Adds Quick Records, expanded livestock record types and adaptive setup fields to the web app.
